new.text: 7.2.4.11.12 Rte_Rips_NotifyTpRxIndication [SWS_Rte_05334] Definition of API function Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpRxIndi- cation_<CGI> ⌈ Service Name Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpRxIndication_<CGI> Syntax void Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpRxIndication_<CGI> ( CbkHandleIdType ComUserCbkHandleId, Std_ReturnType result ) Service ID [hex] 0x010b Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant for same sn, otherwise Reentrant ComUserCbkHandleId Handle Id of the Com user callback invoking the API Parameters (in) result E_OK: The I-PDU was received successfully. E_NOT_OK: Reception of the I-PDU failed. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description Rte_Rips_NotifyTpRxIndication will be called to notify the RTE Implementation Plug-In when an I-PDU is received via the TP for the LdCom signal used for the Data Communication Graph requiring transformation, with the result indicating whether the transmission was successful or not. This function is designed to be a plug-in proxy for the LdCom TP Rte_LdComCbkTpRx Indication callback. See requirement [SWS_Com_00650] for more details on the functionality of this callback. Available via Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>.h ⌋ [SWS_Rte_05335] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00301, SRS_Rte_00312, SRS_Rte_00317 ⌈The associated Local Software Cluster Communication Plug-In shall provide the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpRxIndication_<CGI> Service for each • dataElement instance in an AbstractRequiredPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component • operation instance in a PortPrototype of an Atomic Software Compo- nent • trigger instance in an AbstractRequiredPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component IF • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794]. AND • the Communication Graph references an ComIPdu which has its ComIPdu- Type parameter set to TP [SWS_COM_00921]. ⌋ [SWS_Rte_05336] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 ⌈The RTE shall call all Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpRxIndication_<CGI> Services from the Rte_COMCbkTpRxIndication callback for Communication Graphs where • The communication graph references a ComIPdu which has its ComIPduDirec- tion parameter set to COM_RECEIVE [SWS_COM_00921] AND • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794]. ⌋ [SWS_Rte_05337] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 ⌈When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpRxIndication_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkTpRxIndication callback, the RTE shall pass through the following IN parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpRxIndication_<CGI> call: • result The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpRxIndication_- <CGI> shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_COMCbkT- pRxIndication callback.⌋
